privacy_policy: Media, vendor binaries, exact private commands/probes/logs and personal tags remain outside Git. Public observations are allowlisted technical identities, hashes and synthetic fixture tags. No original personal source or ordinary Music directory was accessed for this preparation.

preparer.parser_method: Each explicitly launched executable used -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command and Parser.ParseFile against the complete final preparer. Both returned zero parser errors and exit 0. No PS5.1 application matrix is claimed.

actual_preparation_launch.native_tool_parameters: Omitted; actual defaults C:\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe and C:\ffmpeg\bin\ffprobe.exe were version queried and hashed before/after.
actual_preparation_launch.environment: Preparation child inherited its exec-command environment without modifications; exact inherited values were not captured. The separate owned application wrapper prepended the verified FFmpeg/ffprobe directories to its own PATH and removed its inherited PSModulePath before invoking the unchanged app. No parent/global environment, machine setting, policy or dependency installation was changed.

synthetic_phone_expectations.artwork: Both short MP3s have one attached 64x64 solid blue JPEG picture.
synthetic_phone_expectations.ordering: Album track order should be First track then Second track. Alphabetical filename order intentionally places A-second before Z-first. Actual player ordering remains a phone observation.
synthetic_phone_expectations.player_limitations: Chapter data is present in the first MP3, but chapter display/navigation, resume, cover presentation and sorting depend on the actual player and remain not run.

process_and_validation_scope.application_records: Both synthetic inputs are Converted, Completed/exit 0, default 64 kbps, with exact copied runtime identities. Manifest records do not contain per-native ProcessReleased fields.
process_and_validation_scope.runtime_success_semantics: The unchanged reviewed runtime gates successful conversion and validation on its owned native-process release checks. This is source behavior corroborated by the completed application and independent short-output probes/full decodes, not a separately observed descendant-process inventory.
process_and_validation_scope.report_release_flag_scope: all_native_processes_released refers to all sixteen direct Invoke-AudioNativeProcess calls, including the PowerShell application wrapper host. It does not independently establish containment or release of descendants after a hypothetical host-controller timeout.
process_and_validation_scope.timeout_limitation: The helper deadline cancels its directly retained process. For the nested application host, independent descendant containment on timeout is not proven by this preparer. Failed/timeout roots are retained, no cleanup/recovery or descendant-release success is claimed, and follow-up inspection would be required before any such scope could be cleaned.

retention: The new exclusive marker-owned T21 TEMP root, exact preparer snapshot, app copies, fixtures, real app output, private captures and Phone folder remain retained. The original selected T20 root/report/raw record and long output remain unchanged. No recursive deletion was attempted.
evidence_boundary: This establishes local payload preparation and byte provenance. A51/A52 require named observations on the actual phone/player and remain not run.
